clauses.title: Limits of Risk Covered
clauses.source_text: The total coverage provided under this Policy for any single Insured Person during the Policy Period shall not exceed the specified limits in the Policy Schedule.
clauses.reason: High level statement of coverage limits, details are in specific benefit sections.

clauses.title: Accidental Death Benefit
clauses.source_text: Accidental Death occurring within 183 days of the accident: Compensation 100% of Sum Insured.
clauses.reason: Specifies 100% limit of Sum Insured for Accidental Death.

clauses.title: Permanent Total Disability (PTD)
clauses.source_text: Permanent Total Disability: Compensation 100% of Sum Insured.

clauses.title: Accidental Insurance Exceptions
clauses.source_text: The Company shall not be liable to make any payment for intentional self-injury, suicide, under influence of liquor or narcotics, hazardous sports, criminal acts, war.
clauses.reason: Clear exclusion rules based on cause/reason of injury.

clauses.title: Category A - Hospital Admission Room Bed and ICU Charges
clauses.source_text: Hospital Admission, Room & Bed Charges, ICU Charges (per illness episode): Up to 30% of Medical Sum Insured.
clauses.reason: Deterministic sub-limit calculation (30% of Medical Sum Insured).

clauses.title: Category B - Diagnostic Procedures
clauses.source_text: Diagnostic Procedures, Pathology, Radiology, Laboratory Tests: Up to 20% of Medical Sum Insured.
clauses.reason: Deterministic sub-limit calculation (20% of Medical Sum Insured).

clauses.title: Category C - Professional Fees and OT Charges
clauses.source_text: Doctor/Surgeon Fees, Nursing Expenses, Operation Theatre Charges, Surgical Appliances, Medicines & Drugs, Local Ambulance Charges: Up to 50% of Medical Sum Insured.
clauses.reason: Deterministic sub-limit calculation (50% of Medical Sum Insured).

clauses.title: Mandatory Excess Deductible
clauses.source_text: A compulsory deductible of First Rs. 500 shall apply to each and every admissible medical claim.
clauses.reason: HIPML ANTLR grammar defines copay % on policy attributes but does not have a dedicated deductible flat amount token; handled in ClaimSetu settlement layer.

clauses.title: Initial 30-Day Waiting Period
clauses.source_text: Treatments undergone within the first 30 days from the inception date of the Policy, except in cases of emergency accidental injury.

clauses.title: Cosmetic & Plastic Surgery Exception
clauses.source_text: Cosmetics, plastic surgery, aesthetic treatments, weight management unless medically necessary due to an accident.
clauses.reason: Deterministic exclusion rule with 'Excluded unless' clause.

clauses.title: Dental Care Exception
clauses.source_text: Routine eye examinations, dental care or surgery, cost of spectacles, contact lenses, and hearing aids.
clauses.reason: General exclusion for routine dental and optical services.

clauses.title: Geographical Limit (Nepal and India)
clauses.source_text: Medical treatment received outside the geographical boundaries of Nepal and India.

clauses.title: Maximum Age Limit (70 Years)
clauses.source_text: Medical treatment for any Insured Person above the age of 70 years.

clauses.title: Calculi First Year Waiting Period
clauses.source_text: Kidney stones, gallstones, or urinary tract calculi during the first year of coverage (eligible only upon continuous renewal).

clauses.title: Covered Critical Illnesses
clauses.source_text: This benefit pays a fixed sum insured as specified in the Schedule upon the first diagnosis of any of the eighteen (18) Critical Illnesses (Cancer, Kidney Failure, CABG, Stroke, etc.).
clauses.reason: Fixed critical illness benefit subject to 30 days initial waiting period.

clauses.title: Medical Definitions for Critical Illnesses
clauses.source_text: Medical definitions and criteria for Benign Brain Tumor, Parkinson's Disease, Coma, Deafness, etc.
clauses.reason: Diagnostic definitions for RAG retrieval and medical evidence verification.

clauses.title: Proof of Loss / Claim Documents
clauses.source_text: The Insured must submit all original medical bills, discharge summaries, diagnostic reports, and completed claim forms.
clauses.reason: Procedural requirement; retained for RAG documentation verification.

clauses.title: Litigation Time Limits
clauses.source_text: No legal action may be brought against the Company after the expiry of 3 months from final rejection.
